title: review: C-C: daemon advances tasks — dispatch on ready, gate, review, merge, dependents; pipeline stamps; locked writes
spec:
Why: every pipeline hop waits for the Planner today (scout T-0045: daemon.tick only requeues dead pids). Depends on C-B (depends_on, ready()) and C-D (spec_review verdict) merged into goal/T-0043.

What (3 files: orchestrator/daemon.py, orchestrator/bus.py (lock helper only), tests/test_daemon.py; worktree off goal/T-0043):
1. bus.py: `with bus.locked():` context manager using fcntl.flock on STATE/bus.lock; wrap _save() and update() bodies in it (cheap; same pattern as merge.lock). Pool.save is out of scope; the daemon builds a fresh Pool() per tick to reduce staleness.
2. daemon.py, new stages in tick(pool), each guarded by a `pipeline` dict on the task json with stage timestamps, written via bus.update inside the lock so a stage runs once:
   - dispatch: for execute tasks with status queued, `bus.ready(t)` True, and (complexity < 5 or t.get("spec_review_verdict") == "approve"): render .orchestrator/prompts/execute.md and call executor.start(t["id"], prompt); stamp pipeline.dispatched_at. If complexity ≥ 5 and no spec_review task exists for it yet, create one (bus.create_task role spec_review, inputs=[id], parent=t["parent"], acceptance/scope copied) and spawn it via spawn.run_worker in a thread; stamp pipeline.spec_review_at. On request_changes: bus.update(status held, hold_reason "spec_review request_changes"), notify.
   - gate+review: for execute tasks done with merged_into unset and pipeline.gated_at unset: run TESTS_GREEN (merge.TESTS_GREEN) on t["worktree"]; red → status held, hold_reason "gate_red", notify; green → if complexity ≤ 3 call merge.merge(id) directly, else create a review task (role review, inputs=[id], complexity = t complexity, parent, acceptance/scope copied) and spawn it; stamp gated_at.
   - merge: for review tasks done whose inputs[0] execute task has review_verdict approve and merged_into unset: merge.merge(inputs[0]); on merged, stamp merged_at and notify; on conflict/tests_red the merge already sets status failed — notify. review_verdict request_changes → hold the execute task with hold_reason "review request_changes", notify (the Planner writes the fix-round spec).
   - dependents: nothing extra; dispatch picks up ready tasks next tick.
   Never re-spawn a task with a live pid; keep the existing dead-pid requeue. Keep tick() total work bounded (one dispatch per executor slot per tick).
3. `orchestrator daemon --once` runs a single tick (for tests and for the Planner). tests/test_daemon.py: with executor.start, spawn.run_worker, merge.merge and subprocess.run monkeypatched to record calls: (a) B depends_on A: tick dispatches A only; after A merged_into set, next tick dispatches B; (b) complexity 6 task is not dispatched until spec_review_verdict approve; a spec_review task is created once; (c) done execute task at complexity 2 with a fake green gate → merge called; at complexity 5 → review task created and spawned once across two ticks; (d) red gate → held with hold_reason gate_red and no review created; (e) review approve → merge called; request_changes → execute task held.

Run `uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests`. Commit: "daemon: dependency-driven dispatch, gate, review, merge with pipeline stamps; bus write lock" with a revert-path body.
acceptance: uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests exits 0 with the five daemon scenarios
a task with unmet depends_on is never dispatched; a complexity >=5 task waits for spec_review_verdict approve
each stage runs at most once per task across repeated ticks (pipeline stamps)
red gate or request_changes leaves the task held with a hold_reason and calls notify
bus._save/update run under an flock on .orchestrator/bus.lock
git diff --stat limited to orchestrator/daemon.py, orchestrator/bus.py, orchestrator/cli.py (only the --once flag), tests/test_daemon.py
